name: Ultralytics YOLO26s
role: One-shot photographic object detection only; YOLO12 optical target recovery is preserved
output: Apple object detector NMS pipeline: confidence and coordinates; VNRecognizedObjectObservation
classes: 80 COCO object classes, not a photographic composition model
fallback: Logged load, prediction or output-schema failures retry with all compute units, then YOLO12s; cancellation aborts immediately. Thermal/low-power mode uses the retained optical detector.
validationScope: Production Swift/Core ML CADB functional checks and a frozen 96-image labelled COCO val2017 subset compared with YOLO12s. Reports are generated during CI; this source manifest contains no invented evaluation results or physical iPhone performance claims.
